description.value: Side Quest Brewing Co. is a craft brewery taproom in Port Coquitlam whose beers are inspired by gaming, fantasy, and adventure. The taproom maintains a large board game library and hosts community events, making it a sociable stop for groups. The rebranded operation occupies a unit in an industrial-style complex on Sherling Place.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content clearly shows the business has rebranded from 'Northpaw Brew Co' to 'Side Quest Brewing Co.' — the OSM name 'Northpaw Tasting Room' is outdated. The website confirms the address as '2150-570 Sherling Place, Port Coquitlam, BC', matching the OSM street address and unit tag but contradicting the OSM community field ('North Vancouver'). No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the sparse website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Northpaw Tasting Room' but the business has rebranded to 'Side Quest Brewing Co.' — the OSM node should be updated.
Community mismatch: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the website explicitly states the taproom is in Port Coquitlam.
Website domain (northpawbrewco.com) still reflects the old brand name; the business may update it, which could break the OSM website tag.
Website content is very sparse (768 bytes) — no amenity details are confirmable from it.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record contains significantly stale data (wrong business name, wrong community). The rebranded taproom could be a reasonable cyclist stop, but the listing requires OSM correction and amenity verification before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM email tag (info@northpawbrewco.com) also reflects the old brand and may be outdated. Recommend verifying current contact details directly with the business.
